tabGroup.head.tooltip: Collapse or expand the group; drag to move the group; hover lists the tabs of a collapsed group
tabGroup.dialog.title: Rename group and choose color
rejoin.title: Rejoin parts
rejoin.message: This document is stored in several files. Should they be merged back into a single one? This deletes {n} part files.
rejoin.detail: The content is kept in full and will afterwards live in one file.
rejoin.detailTooLarge: Careful: the rejoined document is larger than the size at which splitting starts. It will therefore be split again on the next save. No content is lost, but the command has no lasting effect.
split.announceMessage: This document has grown so large that the application will split it into several files when saving.
split.announceDetail: The parts stay in the same folder and are still opened and edited as a single document. Cuts are only made at headings of the top two levels. If you choose ‹Read only›, the file stays undivided and will no longer be saved in this tab.
window.unresponsiveMessage: The display of this window has not responded for {n} seconds.
window.unresponsiveDetail: Unsaved changes in this window can no longer be saved. Other windows are unaffected and stay open.
window.crashMessage: The display of this window failed and was terminated.
window.crashDetail: The open files can be restored. Unsaved changes in this window are lost; other windows are unaffected.
window.crashRepeatDetail: This is the second failure of this window. Reloading would probably repeat it, so the window will be closed. Other windows are unaffected.
